events.summary: The first retained Apple DocC state after iOS 26.1 Beta 1 and before Beta 2 contains 15 substantive, itemized developer-note entries.

blocks.text: Release identity
This article enriches the existing iOS 26.1 Beta 1 route dated 2025-09-22. It does not alter the audited timeline date or create a second event.
Archived Apple note state

Internet Archive retained Apple's human documentation shell and its structured DocC payload during the interval after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. The raw document identifies itself as the iOS 26.1 beta notes and contains 15 itemized entries represented here.
Documented initial inventory

The preserved state covers Background Assets, Game Controller, HealthKit, Keyboard, Nearby Interaction, Siri, SwiftUI, and UIKit. Resolved issues, new capabilities, API changes, and known issues remain separately labeled in the structured inventory.
Attribution boundary

This is direct initial-snapshot evidence, not a claim that every item appeared at the exact release hour. The raw capture falls before Beta 2, so no later milestone is crossed and no final cumulative note is copied backward.

Game Controller — Resolved Issues; 159124910; raw payload 20250927080956
SwiftUI — Resolved Issues; 158236264 and FB19613386; raw payload 20250927080956

changes.title: Background Assets local URL lookup fix
changes.canonicalSummary: Background Assets corrected local file URL lookup so an already downloaded asset could be located without an unexpected error.
changes.summary: The initial archived note state records a fix for AssetPackManager URL lookup when the requested asset file is already stored locally.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

citations.locator: Background Assets — Resolved Issues; 157959878 and FB19512759; raw payload 20250927080956

changes.title: Game controller press timestamp correction
changes.canonicalSummary: Game Controller corrected the time domain used by the last-pressed-state timestamp.
changes.summary: Apple's initial beta notes mark the incorrect time domain returned by the pressed-state timestamp as resolved.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

citations.locator: Game Controller — Resolved Issues; 159124910; raw payload 20250927080956

changes.title: Unified blood-pressure authorization control
changes.canonicalSummary: HealthKit combined systolic and diastolic blood-pressure authorization into one interface control while retaining separate API requests.
changes.summary: The archived state describes one blood-pressure switch in authorization UI and tells applications to continue requesting both underlying data types.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Blood-pressure correlation validation fix
changes.canonicalSummary: HealthKit corrected blood-pressure correlation saving around the required systolic and diastolic sample pairing.
changes.summary: The initial note state records corrected validation for blood-pressure correlation objects and their paired quantity samples.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Keyboard diacritical selection known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple documented that choosing a diacritical mark or character variant could insert only the base character.
changes.summary: The Beta 1 archive warns that the character-variant chooser could discard the selected variant and enter its unmodified base character.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Additional Nearby Interaction UWB parameters
changes.canonicalSummary: Nearby Interaction configuration gained support for additional ultra-wideband parameters, including hopping mode.
changes.summary: The archived developer notes add more UWB configuration options to NINearbyAccessoryConfiguration and identify hopping mode as an example.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Nearby Interaction DLTDOA session known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple documented that starting a Nearby Interaction session with DLTDOA configuration could return an error.
changes.summary: The initial state flags an error when NISession runs with an NIDLTDOAConfiguration.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Portuguese Siri News fallback known issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Portuguese Siri requests about News could fall back to web search or ChatGPT.
changes.summary: Apple's Beta 1 notes warn that Portuguese News questions might be routed away from the intended Siri result.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Portuguese Siri voice-preview mismatch
changes.canonicalSummary: The Siri voice preview could default to older Brazilian Portuguese voices instead of the new Portugal Portuguese choices.
changes.summary: The archived state identifies a pt-BR preview fallback and suggests selecting Voice 2 and asking Siri a question to hear the pt-PT voice.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: Initial pt-PT Siri pronunciation issues
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple documented pronunciation and word-stress problems in the initial Portugal Portuguese Siri voices.
changes.summary: The initial beta state asks for feedback on pronunciation and stress problems in the first pt-PT voice set.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: SwiftUI Animatable macro back-deployment
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI made the Animatable macro available back to iOS 13 and aligned legacy platform versions.
changes.summary: The archived notes extend the macro's declared availability to iOS 13, macOS 10.15, tvOS 13, and watchOS 6.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: SwiftUI toolbar button symbol fix
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI corrected toolbar buttons that showed text instead of a symbol when no explicit label was supplied.
changes.summary: Apple marks the unintended text rendering of implicitly labeled toolbar buttons as resolved.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

changes.title: SwiftUI navigation indicator crash fix
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI corrected a navigationLinkIndicatorVisibility crash on older aligned releases when applications are rebuilt with the 26.1 SDK.
changes.summary: The initial notes require recompilation against the 26.1 SDK to receive the navigation-indicator compatibility fix.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from the first CDX-confirmed Apple DocC state after Beta 1 and before Beta 2. This records the initial documented beta state; it does not assert the exact hour each item first appeared.

events.summary: The first retained iOS 26.2 raw note state identifies itself as Beta 2 and contains one AirDrop issue that explicitly compares Beta 1 with Beta 2.

blocks.text: Release identity
This article enriches the existing iOS 26.2 Beta 2 route dated 2025-11-12. It does not alter the audited timeline date or create a second event.
Direct Beta 2 evidence

The raw Apple DocC payload identifies itself as the Beta 2 release notes. Its AirDrop entry expressly distinguishes devices configured on Beta 1 from devices running Beta 2, making that one behavior route-specific without relying on a cumulative-note inference.

citations.locator: Human capture 20251117094838; raw payload 20251117094839; self-identifying Beta 2 state

blocks.text: Documented Beta 2 issue
Apple records a discoverability failure across the two beta states and gives two workarounds: update both devices to Beta 2 or store the other device owner's Apple Account contact details.

citations.locator: Human capture 20251117094838; raw payload 20251117094839; self-identifying Beta 2 state

blocks.text: Attribution boundary

The archive has no earlier 26.2 raw payload, and this capture occurred on the Beta 3 calendar date while still carrying a Beta 2 title. The remaining cumulative entries are excluded; only the statement that explicitly names Beta 1 and Beta 2 is attached to this route.

citations.locator: Human capture 20251117094838; raw payload 20251117094839; self-identifying Beta 2 state

changes.title: AirDrop cross-beta discoverability issue
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple documented that devices left in Everyone mode on 26.2 Beta 1 might not be discoverable from devices running Beta 2.
changes.summary: The self-identifying Beta 2 note recommends updating both devices to Beta 2 or ensuring that their Apple Account contact details are mutually saved.
changes.verificationMethod: Direct fact from a raw Apple DocC payload whose title identifies Beta 2 and whose AirDrop entry explicitly compares 26.2 Beta 1 with Beta 2. Other cumulative entries in that first retained state are intentionally excluded.
